results: Emergency without any goal invokes the exact registered mode listener; no fictional goal/deadline
Confirmed Emergency clears only the selected widget goal, then activates existing mode override
Switching Emergency off uses existing Smart mode input and does not recreate an ended widget goal
Existing Flow-created goal stays persistent when Emergency mode is chosen
Invalid action or missing listener cannot clear the previous valid widget goal
Duplicate confirmations with the same request ID execute the central mode action once
Controller double-confirmation works without a plan and without completing a target/time draft
